public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve explicit subject assignments on loaded objects**

When a loaded dashboard contains `viewers`, assigning `dashboard.viewers = [subject_id]` together with `dashboard.roles = [role_id]` silently discards the explicitly assigned subject on save. `_read_keys` records the original response keys and does not change on assignment, so this condition treats the new viewers list as untouched server data and replaces it with only the resolved role. This contradicts the resolver's documented behavior of retaining subjects explicitly supplied through the new field and also affects `editors`/`owners` and RLS `subjects`/`roles`. Track assignments after loading rather than using original key presence to decide whether to retain the current list.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
